method: Extracts DOS7 interrupt-code and stackinit source from the formal file; provides BIOS vector labels, BIOS data and diagnostic ORG-based target offsets; assembles and links, then applies MZ relocations.
limitations: The harness uses ORG and isolated synthesized segment layout; it is not a production build.
This comparison does not establish the final source module order, full SYSINIT layout, runtime behavior or complete IO.SYS.
No stack allocator or message-resource integration is verified by this particular comparison.
